marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 龍仔尾‧ 貓 | Long zi wei, mao
Kan shi jie de fang fa ; 216

Longzawei is a small village nestled beneath the Coastal Mountain Range of the East Rift Valley—an obscure name not easily found on maps, home to generations of hardworking, humble people. During a great pandemic, Chiang Hsun unexpectedly found himself staying in a farmhouse in Longzawei. His body was placed under quarantine, yet his spirit seemed to roam freely in a kind of Peach Blossom Spring. Dragons appeared before his eyes, mist and waterfalls drifted like smoke—vivid, full of life. A few cats lingered, reluctant to leave. The vast world felt like a prison, and there, in idleness, he watched the clouds come and go. He saw that the affairs of the world are neither right nor wrong, yet life is undeniably shaped by cause and effect
